name: Shippo
description:
Shippo is multi-carrier shipping software that lets e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, and platforms connect to shipping carriers around the world (USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and 40+ more) from one API. 

This connector brings that to Claude: compare real-time rates, create shipments and buy or refund labels, validate and standardize addresses, track packages, handle customs for international orders, schedule pickups, generate manifests, and run batch shipments, all against your Shippo account. 

Read and write are separate tools, so state-changing actions can require approval. Sign in once with Shippo over OAuth.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Shippo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shippo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.shippo.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Shippo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shippo provides these MCP tools: shippo_list_tools, shippo_describe_tool, shippo_read_execute_tool, and shippo_write_execute_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shippo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Shippo in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Shippo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Shippo is developed by Shippo. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
